shared_elements: predatory quadruped/animal head with prominent eyes and muzzle
human-like figure with arms bent and hands shown
grid, net or zigzag patterned band
stacked/registered composition of figures one above another
animal placed above a human figure
small subsidiary figures beside a larger one
justification: Both surfaces stack a large-headed predatory animal directly above an anthropomorphic figure whose arms and hands are shown pressed against the body, and both include a distinctive net/grid patterned band as a divider or infill, which is an unusually specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in content is that A adds a whole further repertoire (birds in profile, snake- or plant-like sinuous motifs, a row of repeated animal heads across the top) laid out in flat registers, whereas B shows only the animal-over-human pair worked as a frontal, in-the-round column with no accompanying creatures.
